# Republicans during the Wilson Years, 1913–1921

Oxford University Press eBooks. Published: 2014-10-16. Book chapter. 0 citations.

## Abstract

This chapter details events following the losses experienced by the Republicans in the 1912 elections. This defeat left the Republicans in a temporary state of confusion and disarray. After sixteen years of national power, they had lost control of the presidency and Congress at the same time. They faced the bitter legacy of the divisive rupture between Roosevelt and Taft. They viewed the new Democratic president Woodrow Wilson with a mixture of suspicion and more than a little contempt.
